gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-habibi: Oldtimer draws its round forms like open parentheses, with a fixed-pen line that never swells on a downstroke. And Habibi, a classic serif, follows with a clear channel running into each round letter.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-inika: Oldtimer sets round, parenthesis-like shapes in a display heading where every stroke ends at one measured thickness, while Inika adds a text serif with see-through s shapes. Paragraphs flow traditionally.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-kay-pho-du: Kay Pho Du brings a classic serif whose counters breathe like a hollow reed, each stroke trailing like a rolling-ball pen, under Oldtimer's round headings. Its strongest quality is that old-fashioned command.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-labrada: Wirelike strokes of a single thickness give Oldtimer its round, parenthesis-like display look, a heading with plenty of command. Labrada, a text serif with wide openings on its small letters, does the quieter, dignified work of carrying the text.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-laila: Oldtimer opens with round, parenthesis-shaped forms and no shading. Laila, a text serif, then adds generous space between each curve end and its stem, so the heading's authority eases into editorial, traditional text.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-montaga: Montaga leaves its pen-lifted curves unfinished, with strokes like thread stitched along a path, a bookish serif under the heading. And Oldtimer's round, shade-free forms give the pair its strongest quality, a classic, commanding display voice.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-rhodium-libre: A tube-like, constant-width stroke makes Oldtimer's round, parenthesis-shaped letters unmistakable, and they feel classic and commanding in display. It earns its keep big and short, above Rhodium Libre.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-rokkitt: Oldtimer's wire-like monoline skeleton turns round forms into parentheses. Rokkitt, a serif with a bent-paperclip c, gives the pair its strongest quality: a bookish, traditional body beneath a commanding display heading.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-sanchez: Sanchez opens its c like a pair of calipers, bookish and dignified. Oldtimer, with its pencil-line consistency and round parenthesis forms, earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-gf-solway: Authoritative from the first line, Solway brings a classic serif with sign-painter's flatness of weight and a generous entry into the e's eye. Oldtimer's round display forms handle the commanding headline, while Solway holds the text.
